ui.real_players_raid_your_village_instea.en: Real players raid your village instead of bots, the opponents you scout are real villages (or wild ones when nobody fits), and your Alliance is a real Alliance. Your village itself still lives on this device.
ui.real_players_raid_your_village_instea.text: Namesto botov tvojo vas napadajo pravi igralci, nasprotniki, ki jih izvidiš, so prave vasi (ali divje, ko se nihče ne ujema), tvoje zavezništvo pa je pravo zavezništvo. Sama vas še vedno živi v tej napravi.

ui.that_ring_is_full_send_the_rest_throu.en: That ring is full. Send the rest through another glowing ring.

ui.the_home_screen_app_keeps_its_own_vil.en: The Home Screen app keeps its own village, apart from Safari’s. To bring yours here: open Kagemura in Safari, go to Settings → Copy save code, then come back and use Settings → Load from code.
ui.the_home_screen_app_keeps_its_own_vil.text: Aplikacija na začetnem zaslonu ima svojo vas, ločeno od Safarijeve. Da prineseš svojo sem: odpri Kagemuro v Safariju, pojdi v Nastavitve → Kopiraj kodo shranjene igre, nato se vrni in uporabi Nastavitve → Naloži iz kode.

ui.the_item_is_delivered_at_once_by_buyi.en: The item is delivered at once; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
ui.the_item_is_delivered_at_once_by_buyi.text: Izdelek je dostavljen takoj; z nakupom se strinjaš, da izgubiš pravico do odstopa, kot to za digitalne vsebine dovoljuje zakon.

ui.the_league_season_ended_your_chest_wa.en: The league season ended: your chest was added. See Honor for details.
ui.the_league_season_ended_your_chest_wa.text: Ligaška sezona je končana: tvoja skrinja je dodana. Podrobnosti so pod Čast.

ui.the_new_version_could_not_be_download.en: The new version could not be downloaded right now. Check your connection and try again.
ui.the_new_version_could_not_be_download.text: Nove različice trenutno ni bilo mogoče prenesti. Preveri povezavo in poskusi znova.

ui.the_next_alliance_war_starts_in_and_l.en: The next Alliance War starts in {arg1} and lasts {arg2} days. Every member gets {arg3} attacks; the best stars on each enemy base add up, and the Alliance with more stars wins.
ui.the_next_alliance_war_starts_in_and_l.text: Naslednja vojna zavezništev se začne čez {arg1} in traja toliko dni: {arg2}. Vsak član ima {arg3} napadov; najboljše zvezdice na vsaki sovražni bazi se seštejejo in zmaga zavezništvo z več zvezdicami.

ui.the_raider_held_this_rematch_is_used_.en: The raider held. This rematch is used up.
ui.the_raider_held_this_rematch_is_used_.text: Napadalčeva baza je zdržala. Ta povratni dvoboj je porabljen.

ui.the_server_could_not_take_this_villag.en: The server could not take this village: {arg1}
ui.the_server_could_not_take_this_villag.text: Strežnik te vasi ni mogel sprejeti: {arg1}

ui.the_server_did_not_accept_your_raid_o.en: The server did not accept your raid on {arg1}. It counts as practice: no loot or honor.{arg2}
ui.the_server_did_not_accept_your_raid_o.text: Strežnik ni sprejel tvojega vpada: {arg1}. Šteje kot vaja: brez plena in časti.{arg2}

ui.the_squad_courtyards_are_spoken_for_t.en: The Squad Courtyards are spoken for: train ahead for the next army
ui.the_squad_courtyards_are_spoken_for_t.text: Dvorišča odredov so zasedena: uri vnaprej za naslednjo vojsko

ui.the_store_could_not_be_reached_for_pr.en: The store could not be reached for prices. Check your connection and open the Store again.
ui.the_store_could_not_be_reached_for_pr.text: Trgovina za cene ni dosegljiva. Preveri povezavo in znova odpri Trgovino.

ui.the_store_shows_the_final_price_inclu.en: The store shows the final price, including any taxes, before you pay.
ui.the_store_shows_the_final_price_inclu.text: Trgovina pred plačilom pokaže končno ceno, vključno z morebitnimi davki.

ui.the_training_dojo_researches_a_higher.en: The Training Dojo researches {arg1} (a higher Clan Keep opens more research lanes). A new level makes every warrior of that kind stronger, and costs a little more to train. Your Clan Keep level sets the highest level.
ui.the_training_dojo_researches_a_higher.text: Vadbeni dojo raziskuje: {arg1} (višja Klanska trdnjava odpre več raziskovalnih mest). Nova raven okrepi vse bojevnike te vrste, njihovo urjenje pa stane malo več. Raven Klanske trdnjave določa najvišjo raven.

ui.their_full_training_cost_comes_back_a.en: Their full training cost comes back, as far as your storage allows.
ui.their_full_training_cost_comes_back_a.text: Vrne se celotna cena njihovega urjenja, kolikor dopuščajo skladišča.

ui.there_is_no_online_account_on_this_de.en: There is no online account on this device: your village is kept only here. "Start a new village" below erases it; uninstalling the app or clearing this site's data removes it completely.
ui.there_is_no_online_account_on_this_de.text: V tej napravi ni spletnega računa: tvoja vas je shranjena le tukaj. »Začni novo vas« spodaj jo izbriše; odstranitev aplikacije ali brisanje podatkov tega spletnega mesta jo odstrani v celoti.

ui.they_are_under_fire_pick_the_smoke_bo.en: They are under fire! Pick the Smoke Bomb, then tap on your warriors.
ui.they_are_under_fire_pick_the_smoke_bo.text: Pod ognjem so! Izberi dimno bombo in tapni na svoje bojevnike.

ui.they_fight_first_in_your_next_attack_.en: They fight first in your next attack and take no Courtyard space.
ui.they_fight_first_in_your_next_attack_.text: V naslednjem napadu se borijo prvi in ne zasedajo prostora na dvorišču.

ui.they_go_home_for_good_you_get_back_of.en: They go home for good. You get back {arg1}% of their training cost, as far as your storage allows.
ui.they_go_home_for_good_you_get_back_of.text: Za vedno gredo domov. Dobiš nazaj {arg1} % cene njihovega urjenja, kolikor dopuščajo skladišča.

ui.they_walk_in_by_themselves_after_a_ra.en: {arg1} They walk in by themselves after a raid, or when you dismiss warriors.
ui.they_walk_in_by_themselves_after_a_ra.text: {arg1} Po vpadu ali ko odpustiš bojevnike, pridejo sami.

ui.they_will_be_able_to_invite_and_to_st.en: They will be able to invite and to start Gang Wars. You stay in the Gang.
ui.they_will_be_able_to_invite_and_to_st.text: Novo vodstvo bo lahko vabilo in začenjalo vojne tolp. Ti ostaneš v tolpi.

ui.this_browser_can_t_save_your_village_.en: This browser can't save your village: progress is lost when this page closes. Use a normal (not private) window, or copy a save code in Settings.
ui.this_browser_can_t_save_your_village_.text: Ta brskalnik ne more shraniti tvoje vasi: napredek se izgubi, ko se ta stran zapre. Uporabi navadno (ne zasebno) okno ali kopiraj kodo shranjene igre v Nastavitvah.

ui.this_browser_may_delete_this_village_.en: This browser may delete this village if you stay away for a while. To keep it: install Kagemura (the browser menu → Install app or Add to Home screen), link a sign-in under Online play, or copy a save code.
ui.this_browser_may_delete_this_village_.text: Ta brskalnik lahko to vas izbriše, če te nekaj časa ni. Da jo obdržiš: namesti Kagemuro (meni brskalnika → Namesti aplikacijo ali Dodaj na začetni zaslon), poveži prijavo pod Spletna igra ali kopiraj kodo shranjene igre.

ui.this_browser_may_delete_your_village_.en: This browser may delete your village if you stay away for a week.
ui.this_browser_may_delete_your_village_.text: Ta brskalnik lahko tvojo vas izbriše, če te teden dni ni.

ui.this_browser_mode_cannot_save_your_vi.en: This browser mode cannot save. Your village will be lost when you close the page.
ui.this_browser_mode_cannot_save_your_vi.text: Ta način brskalnika ne more shranjevati. Tvoja vas se bo izgubila, ko zapreš stran.

ui.this_device_could_not_store_your_late.en: This device could not store your latest actions (storage full or blocked). They are being sent to the server now; free some space to keep playing offline safely.
ui.this_device_could_not_store_your_late.text: Ta naprava ni mogla shraniti tvojih zadnjih dejanj (prostor je poln ali blokiran). Zdaj se pošiljajo na strežnik; sprosti nekaj prostora, da lahko varno igraš brez povezave.

ui.this_device_still_holds_your_online_a.en: This device still holds your online account on
ui.this_device_still_holds_your_online_a.text: Ta naprava še hrani tvoj spletni račun na

ui.this_device_will_play_the_account_lin.en: This device will play the account linked to that sign-in. If its village is kept on the server, it replaces the village here, which stays as a backup in Settings. Your current online account is not deleted.
ui.this_device_will_play_the_account_lin.text: Ta naprava bo igrala račun, povezan s to prijavo. Če je njegova vas shranjena na strežniku, nadomesti vas tukaj, ki ostane kot varnostna kopija v Nastavitvah. Tvoj trenutni spletni račun ni izbrisan.

ui.this_is_a_server_for_testing_villages.en: This is a {arg1} server for testing: villages and purchases here are separate from the real game.
ui.this_is_a_server_for_testing_villages.text: To je strežnik {arg1} za testiranje: vasi in nakupi tukaj so ločeni od prave igre.

ui.this_is_the_testing_sandbox_a_separat.en: This is the testing sandbox: a separate practice village with online play off. Skipping time moves the sandbox clock ahead for good; your real village is never affected.
ui.this_is_the_testing_sandbox_a_separat.text: To je testni peskovnik: ločena vadbena vas z izklopljeno spletno igro. Preskok časa uro peskovnika za vedno premakne naprej; tvoja prava vas ni nikoli prizadeta.

ui.this_starts_a_new_village_that_is_kep.en: This starts a new village that is kept on the server. The village on this device stays as a backup you can restore in Settings.
ui.this_starts_a_new_village_that_is_kep.text: S tem se začne nova vas, shranjena na strežniku. Vas v tej napravi ostane kot varnostna kopija, ki jo lahko obnoviš v Nastavitvah.

ui.time_skips_and_test_purchases_live_in.en: Time skips and test purchases live in a separate testing sandbox, so they can never change your real village or online play.
ui.time_skips_and_test_purchases_live_in.text: Preskoki časa in testni nakupi živijo v ločenem testnem peskovniku, zato nikoli ne morejo spremeniti tvoje prave vasi ali spletne igre.

ui.time_until_everyone_who_fits_in_the_s.en: Time until everyone who fits in the Squad Courtyards has finished
ui.time_until_everyone_who_fits_in_the_s.text: Čas, dokler niso izurjeni vsi, ki gredo v Dvorišča odredov

ui.train_some_warriors_first_duels_use_y.en: Train some warriors first: duels use your army (none are spent).
ui.train_some_warriors_first_duels_use_y.text: Najprej izuri nekaj bojevnikov: dvoboji uporabijo tvojo vojsko (nobeden se ne porabi).

ui.train_some_warriors_then_save_the_mix.en: Train some warriors, then save the mix here to refill it later.
ui.train_some_warriors_then_save_the_mix.text: Izuri nekaj bojevnikov in sestavo shrani tukaj, da jo pozneje napolniš.

ui.trained_ahead_they_join_your_army_whe.en: Trained ahead. They join your army when the Squad Courtyards have room. Jade can't finish them until then.
ui.trained_ahead_they_join_your_army_whe.text: Izurjeni vnaprej. Vojski se pridružijo, ko je v Dvoriščih odredov prostor. Do takrat jih žad ne more dokončati.

ui.training_opens_as_soon_as_the_work_is.en: Training opens as soon as the work is done.
ui.training_opens_as_soon_as_the_work_is.text: Urjenje se odpre, takoj ko je delo končano.

ui.two_to_four_friends_against_another_g.en: Two to four friends against another Gang of the same size: 2 hours to prepare, then 22 hours with 2 attacks each. Strike alone, or relay: a relay strike starts from half the damage of your Gang’s last strike on that base (defenders patch up in between). No honor is won or lost; everyone gets a chest.
ui.two_to_four_friends_against_another_g.text: Dva do štirje prijatelji proti drugi tolpi enake velikosti: 2 uri priprave, nato 22 ur z 2 napadoma na vsakega. Udari samostojno ali v štafeti: udarec v štafeti začne s polovico škode zadnjega udarca tvoje tolpe na to bazo (branilci se vmes zakrpajo). Čast se ne pridobi ali izgubi; vsak dobi skrinjo.

ui.until_the_season_ends_20_faster_build.en: Until the season ends: {pct}% faster builds, the {arg1} look and bigger rewards on every tier. Rewards you already earned unlock right away.
ui.until_the_season_ends_20_faster_build.text: Do konca sezone: {pct} % hitrejše gradnje, videz {arg1} in večje nagrade na vsaki stopnici. Že zaslužene nagrade se odklenejo takoj.

ui.update_kagemura_from_then_open_it_aga.en: Update Kagemura from {arg1}, then open it again.
ui.update_kagemura_from_then_open_it_aga.text: Posodobi Kagemuro iz: {arg1}, nato jo znova odpri.

ui.upgrading_your_clan_keep_to_level_unl.en: Upgrading your Clan Keep to level {arg1} unlocks:
ui.upgrading_your_clan_keep_to_level_unl.text: Izboljšava Klanske trdnjave na raven {arg1} odklene:

ui.village_map_drag_to_look_around_pinch.en: Village map. Drag to look around, pinch or scroll to zoom, tap a building to select it. Every action is also on the buttons around the map.
ui.village_map_drag_to_look_around_pinch.text: Zemljevid vasi. Povleci za razgled, uščipni ali drsaj za povečavo, tapni stavbo, da jo izbereš. Vsako dejanje je tudi na gumbih okoli zemljevida.

ui.warriors_need_two_buildings_the_dojo_.en: Warriors need two buildings: the Dojo trains them and the Courtyard houses them.
ui.warriors_need_two_buildings_the_dojo_.text: Bojevniki potrebujejo dve stavbi: dojo jih uri, dvorišče pa nastani.

ui.we_keep_only_an_age_group_on_this_dev.en: We keep only an age group on this device and our server, never your date of birth. Please answer honestly: our support team can correct a mistake.
ui.we_keep_only_an_age_group_on_this_dev.text: V tej napravi in na našem strežniku hranimo le starostno skupino, nikoli datuma rojstva. Odgovori iskreno: naša ekipa za podporo lahko napako popravi.

ui.when_the_game_hits_an_error_it_sends_.en: When the game hits an error, it sends the error message, where in the code it happened, the game version and the platform, to help fix it. It does not add your name, Player ID, village or chat, but an error message can sometimes include text the game was working on.
ui.when_the_game_hits_an_error_it_sends_.text: Ko igra naleti na napako, pošlje sporočilo o napaki, mesto v kodi, kjer se je zgodila, različico igre in platformo, da jo lažje odpravimo. Ne doda tvojega imena, ID-ja igralca, vasi ali klepeta, vendar lahko sporočilo o napaki včasih vsebuje besedilo, s katerim je igra delala.

ui.when_the_last_of_this_stack_finishes_.en: When the last of this stack finishes, after everyone ahead of it
ui.when_the_last_of_this_stack_finishes_.text: Ko se konča zadnji iz tega sklopa, za vsemi pred njim

ui.where_you_live_google_play_confirms_a.en: Where you live, Google Play confirms ages for apps. Open the Play Store app, verify your age there, then come back: online play and purchases unlock once Google Play shares your age group.
ui.where_you_live_google_play_confirms_a.text: V tvoji državi Google Play potrjuje starost za aplikacije. Odpri aplikacijo Trgovina Play, tam potrdi svojo starost in se vrni: spletna igra in nakupi se odklenejo, ko Google Play deli tvojo starostno skupino.

ui.where_you_live_the_app_store_confirms.en: Where you live, the App Store confirms ages for apps. Confirm your age in your Apple Account settings, then come back.
ui.where_you_live_the_app_store_confirms.text: V tvoji državi App Store potrjuje starost za aplikacije. Potrdi starost v nastavitvah računa Apple in se vrni.

ui.who_can_find_me_by_name_ed481ead6d.text: Kdo me lahko najde po imenu

ui.win_raids_to_earn_honor_lose_it_when_.en: Win raids to earn honor; lose it when your attacks fail or when raiders beat your village. More honor bring tougher opponents with more loot.
ui.win_raids_to_earn_honor_lose_it_when_.text: Zmaguj v vpadih in pridobivaj čast; izgubiš jo, ko tvoji napadi spodletijo ali ko napadalci premagajo tvojo vas. Več časti prinese močnejše nasprotnike z več plena.

ui.you_are_about_to_spend_of_real_money_.en: You are about to spend {arg1} of real money. Make sure a parent or guardian says it's OK.
ui.you_are_about_to_spend_of_real_money_.text: Porabiti nameravaš {arg1} pravega denarja. Prepričaj se, da se s tem strinja starš ali skrbnik.

ui.you_are_in_the_top_league_8b390ac669.en: You are in the top league!

ui.you_are_playing_on_your_own_opponents.en: You are playing on your own: opponents, raiders and your Alliance are friendly bots (always labelled as computer players). To raid real players and join real Alliances, enter a Kagemura: Ninja Clans server address under Advanced, below.
ui.you_are_playing_on_your_own_opponents.text: Igraš brez drugih igralcev: nasprotniki, napadalci in tvoje zavezništvo so prijazni boti (vedno označeni kot računalniški igralci). Za vpade na prave igralce in prava zavezništva spodaj pod Napredno vnesi naslov strežnika Kagemura: Ninja Clans.

ui.you_can_add_each_other_again_later_01.en: You can add each other again later.

ui.you_can_found_or_join_a_gang_again_af.en: You can found or join a Gang again after 24 hours.
ui.you_can_found_or_join_a_gang_again_af.text: Tolpo lahko znova ustanoviš ali se ji pridružiš čez 24 ur.

ui.you_can_join_another_alliance_straigh.en: You can join another Alliance straight away. Warriors in your Alliance Lodge stay with you.
ui.you_can_join_another_alliance_straigh.text: Takoj se lahko pridružiš drugemu zavezništvu. Bojevniki v tvoji Dvorani zavezništva ostanejo s tabo.

ui.you_can_keep_saved_armies_delete_one_.en: You can keep {arg1} saved armies. Delete one to save this army.
ui.you_can_keep_saved_armies_delete_one_.text: Največje število shranjenih vojsk: {arg1}. Eno izbriši, da shraniš to vojsko.

ui.you_finished_the_training_please_ente.en: You finished the training. Please enter your year of birth: it sets the right protections for your age (spending limits, offers, and for online play who can find you and how you chat).
ui.you_finished_the_training_please_ente.text: Vodič je končan. Vnesi leto rojstva: z njim nastavimo prave zaščite za tvojo starost (omejitve porabe, ponudbe ter pri spletni igri, kdo te lahko najde in kako klepetaš).

ui.you_have_not_cleared_a_tier_yet_cb231.en: You have not cleared a tier yet.

ui.you_have_the_premium_season_scroll_th.en: You have the premium Season Scroll this season.
ui.you_have_the_premium_season_scroll_th.text: To sezono imaš premijski Sezonski zvitek.

ui.you_joined_after_this_war_started_che.en: You joined after this war started: cheer your Gang on.
ui.you_joined_after_this_war_started_che.text: Tvoj pristop je bil po začetku te vojne: navijaj za svojo tolpo.

ui.you_left_a_gang_lately_you_can_found_.en: You left a Gang lately: you can found or join one in {arg1}.
ui.you_left_a_gang_lately_you_can_found_.text: Nedaven izstop iz tolpe: tolpo lahko ustanoviš ali se ji pridružiš čez {arg1}.

ui.you_ll_get_back_of_what_you_paid_5919.en: You'll get back {arg1}% of what you paid.

ui.you_stop_being_friends_and_neither_of.en: You stop being friends, and neither of you can find or ask the other.
ui.you_stop_being_friends_and_neither_of.text: Prijateljstvo se konča in nihče od vaju ne more drugega najti ali mu poslati prošnje.

ui.your_age_group_can_only_be_made_stric.en: Your age group can only be made stricter here. To correct it, contact support from Settings → Privacy and help.
ui.your_age_group_can_only_be_made_stric.text: Starostno skupino lahko tukaj le zaostriš. Za popravek se obrni na podporo v Nastavitve → Zasebnost in pomoč.

ui.your_alliance_is_matched_with_a_real_.en: Your Alliance is matched with a real Alliance of similar size and strength, or with a band of wild bots when none is free. Only members who were in the Alliance when the raid starts take part.
ui.your_alliance_is_matched_with_a_real_.text: Tvoje zavezništvo se pomeri s pravim zavezništvom podobne velikosti in moči ali s skupino divjih botov, ko prostega ni. Sodelujejo le člani, ki so bili v zavezništvu ob začetku vpada.

ui.your_clan_keep_is_at_the_highest_leve.en: Your Clan Keep is at the highest level available right now.
ui.your_clan_keep_is_at_the_highest_leve.text: Tvoja Klanska trdnjava je na najvišji trenutno dosegljivi ravni.

ui.your_current_layout_is_now_your_duel_.en: Your current layout is now your duel layout.
ui.your_current_layout_is_now_your_duel_.text: Trenutna postavitev je zdaj tvoja postavitev za dvoboj.

ui.your_current_village_on_this_device_w.en: Your current village on this device will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_current_village_on_this_device_w.text: Tvoja trenutna vas v tej napravi bo izbrisana. Tega ni mogoče razveljaviti.

ui.your_earlier_village_is_back_the_one_.en: Your earlier village is back. The one you were playing is kept in Settings.
ui.your_earlier_village_is_back_the_one_.text: Tvoja prejšnja vas je spet tu. Vas, ki je bila doslej v igri, je shranjena v Nastavitvah.

ui.your_first_raid_tap_attack_when_you_a.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack! when you are ready.
ui.your_first_raid_tap_attack_when_you_a.text: Tvoj prvi vpad. Tapni Napad!, ko boš nared.

ui.your_friend_code_always_works_share_i.en: Your friend code always works: share it only with people you want to add.
ui.your_friend_code_always_works_share_i.text: Tvoja koda za prijatelje vedno deluje: deli jo le z ljudmi, ki jih želiš dodati.

ui.your_new_village_is_kept_on_the_serve.en: Your new village is kept on the server.
ui.your_new_village_is_kept_on_the_serve.text: Tvoja nova vas je shranjena na strežniku.

ui.your_on_was_interrupted_and_has_been_.en: Your {arg1} on {arg2} was interrupted and has been played out: {arg3}★, {arg4}%. See the battle log.
ui.your_on_was_interrupted_and_has_been_.text: {arg1} ({arg2}) je bil prekinjen in je bil odigran do konca: {arg3}★, {arg4} %. Poglej dnevnik bitk.

ui.your_online_account_was_deleted_a49f2.text: Tvoj spletni račun je bil izbrisan.

ui.your_online_account_was_deleted_resta.en: Your online account was deleted. Restarting offline…
ui.your_online_account_was_deleted_resta.text: Tvoj spletni račun je bil izbrisan. Ponovni zagon brez povezave …

ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.en: Your player name, shared base, Alliance membership, chat messages and warrior requests are deleted from the server now. Online attacks still waiting for the server become practice results. Online play turns off on this device; your village stays. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.text: Tvoje ime igralca, deljena baza, članstvo v zavezništvu, sporočila v klepetu in prošnje za bojevnike se zdaj izbrišejo s strežnika. Spletni napadi, ki še čakajo na strežnik, postanejo vadbeni izidi. Spletna igra se v tej napravi izklopi; tvoja vas ostane. Tega ni mogoče razveljaviti.

ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.en: Your player name, shared base, Alliance and Gang membership, friends, chat messages and any village kept on {arg1} are deleted from that server now. Online play stays off; your village on this device stays. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.text: Tvoje ime igralca, deljena baza, članstvo v zavezništvu in tolpi, prijatelji, sporočila v klepetu in morebitna vas, shranjena na {arg1}, se zdaj izbrišejo s tega strežnika. Spletna igra ostane izklopljena; tvoja vas v tej napravi ostane. Tega ni mogoče razveljaviti.

ui.your_purchase_is_here_but_this_device.en: Your purchase is here, but this device could not save it (storage full?). Free some space: it stays open in the store and is delivered again if needed.
ui.your_purchase_is_here_but_this_device.text: Tvoj nakup je tu, vendar ga ta naprava ni mogla shraniti (poln prostor?). Sprosti nekaj prostora: v trgovini ostane odprt in bo po potrebi znova dostavljen.

ui.your_remaining_troops_go_back_home_yo.en: Your remaining warriors go back home. You keep any loot you already won.
ui.your_remaining_troops_go_back_home_yo.text: Preostali bojevniki se vrnejo domov. Že pridobljeni plen obdržiš.

ui.your_stars_count_toward_the_alliance_.en: Your stars count toward the Alliance War.
ui.your_stars_count_toward_the_alliance_.text: Tvoje zvezdice štejejo v vojni zavezništev.

ui.your_training_dojo_trains_faster_than.en: Your Training Dojo trains {arg1}× faster than a level 1 Dojo.
ui.your_training_dojo_trains_faster_than.text: Tvoj Vadbeni dojo uri {arg1}× hitreje kot dojo ravni 1.

ui.your_village_could_not_be_saved_free_.en: Your village could not be saved ({arg1}). Free some device storage, and copy a save code in Settings to keep it safe.
ui.your_village_could_not_be_saved_free_.text: Tvoje vasi ni bilo mogoče shraniti ({arg1}). Sprosti nekaj prostora v napravi in v Nastavitvah kopiraj kodo shranjene igre, da bo varna.

ui.your_village_is_kept_on_the_server_ev.en: Your village is kept on the server: every change to its resources, buildings, army and research is checked there, so it cannot be lost with this device. What you do is sent as you play; while offline it waits and goes when you reconnect.
ui.your_village_is_kept_on_the_server_ev.text: Tvoja vas je shranjena na strežniku: tam se preveri vsaka sprememba virov, stavb, vojske in raziskav, zato je ne moreš izgubiti skupaj s to napravo. Kar narediš, se pošilja med igranjem; brez povezave počaka in se pošlje, ko se znova povežeš.

ui.your_village_is_now_kept_on_the_serve.en: Your village is now kept on the server.
ui.your_village_is_now_kept_on_the_serve.text: Tvoja vas je zdaj shranjena na strežniku.

ui.your_village_is_on_the_server_now_cou.en: Your village is on the server now. {arg1} could not be matched to a purchase we checked, so it is held for review: contact support from Settings. Your old village is kept as a backup.
ui.your_village_is_on_the_server_now_cou.text: Tvoja vas je zdaj na strežniku. {arg1} ni bilo mogoče povezati s preverjenim nakupom, zato je zadržano v pregledu: obrni se na podporo v Nastavitvah. Tvoja stara vas je shranjena kot varnostna kopija.

ui.your_village_is_saved_and_your_artisa.en: Your village is saved, and your Artisans keep working while you are away.
ui.your_village_is_saved_and_your_artisa.text: Tvoja vas je shranjena, mojstri pa delajo naprej, medtem ko te ni.

ui.your_village_moves_to_the_server_as_i.en: Your village moves to the server as it is, if it is a village its Keep could really have. From then on every change is checked there, and you can play it on other devices by linking a sign-in.
ui.your_village_moves_to_the_server_as_i.text: Tvoja vas se preseli na strežnik takšna, kot je, če je to vas, ki bi jo njena trdnjava res lahko imela. Od takrat se tam preveri vsaka sprememba, igraš pa jo lahko v drugih napravah, če povežeš prijavo.

ui.your_village_saves_automatically_on_t.en: Your village saves automatically on this device. To move it to another device, copy a save code here and load it there.
ui.your_village_saves_automatically_on_t.text: Tvoja vas se v tej napravi shranjuje samodejno. Za prenos v drugo napravo tukaj kopiraj kodo shranjene igre in jo tam naloži.

ui.your_village_was_opened_in_another_ta.en: Your village was opened in another tab or window, and only one can save it. Your progress is safe there.
ui.your_village_was_opened_in_another_ta.text: Tvoja vas je bila odprta v drugem zavihku ali oknu in shranjuje jo lahko le eden. Tvoj napredek je tam varen.

ui.your_village_was_saved_by_a_newer_ver.en: Your village was saved by a newer version of Kagemura, so this version cannot open it. It is safe and unchanged.
ui.your_village_was_saved_by_a_newer_ver.text: Tvojo vas je shranila novejša različica Kagemure, zato je ta različica ne more odpreti. Varna je in nespremenjena.

ui.your_war_base_now_matches_your_villag.en: Your war base now matches your village.
ui.your_war_base_now_matches_your_villag.text: Tvoja vojna baza se zdaj ujema s tvojo vasjo.
